# kion_aws_cloudformation_template (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion Cft by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_aws_cloudformation_template" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the Cft to fetch.
